description: This file contains unit tests for the CallLogHandler class, specifically testing the handling of call log searches, permission requirements, input validation, filtering, pagination, null field handling, parameter clamping, and error mapping. It also includes a fake data source implementation used for testing purposes.

classes.name: FakeCallLogDataSource
classes.description: A mock implementation of CallLogDataSource used in tests to simulate call log data retrieval with configurable permission and failure scenarios.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_requiresPermission
methods.description: Tests that the handler returns an error when permission is not granted.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_rejectsInvalidJson
methods.description: Ensures that invalid JSON input results in an error.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_returnsCallLogs
methods.description: Verifies that a valid request returns correct call log data.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withFilters
methods.description: Tests filtering call logs based on provided criteria.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withPagination
methods.description: Checks pagination functionality with limit and offset.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withDefaultParams
methods.description: Ensures default parameters are used correctly when input is null.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withNullFields
methods.description: Validates handling of call logs with null fields, ensuring proper serialization.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_clampsLimitAndOffsetBeforeSearch
methods.description: Tests that limit and offset parameters are clamped within acceptable bounds before executing search.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_mapsSearchFailuresToUnavailable
methods.description: Checks that internal failures are mapped to user-friendly error codes.
